independent_primary_rechecks.title: SQLite Write-Ahead Logging and WAL-reset advisory
independent_primary_rechecks.released_version_or_commit: Current official SQLite documentation, unpinned; page says last updated 2026-08-25T19:42:39Z.
independent_primary_rechecks.locator: Sections 2.2 and 11–11.2: WAL concurrency, affected/fixed versions and backports, affected connection condition, and the rarity/advisory text.
independent_primary_rechecks.observed_operation: Opened the official primary WAL page and read the concurrency and WAL-reset sections, including the current affected-version range and the later reproducer note; no code or database was executed.
independent_primary_rechecks.governing_condition_default_exception: SQLite states that WAL-reset corruption is possible on WAL databases in versions 3.7.0 through 3.51.2 and fixed in 3.51.3+, with backports in 3.50.7 and 3.44.6. The stated condition is at least two connections to the same database file with concurrent writes/checkpoints. The page characterizes the race as rare and recommends upgrading to a fixed version.
independent_primary_rechecks.applicability: Conditional SQLite selection gate: if this proposal's implementation selects WAL, pin a fixed build/backport and include appropriate multi-connection/checkpoint regression coverage. This does not disqualify SQLite or rollback journaling.
independent_primary_rechecks.limits: The documentation is unpinned and is not a test of a target application, embedded binary, VFS, filesystem, laptop, or regression harness. Individual fetch timestamps were not exposed by the web tool; the UTC time is the immediately observed wrapper clock after retrieval.
